##### Project general facts

Alton by Nshama Group is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a refined collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living. Ideally positioned at the edge of Town Square Park, the project combines sweeping views of lush green spaces and the central boulevard with a calm, family-friendly atmosphere. Its architecture is defined by clean lines, warm natural tones, and expansive windows, creating bright, elegant interiors that balance style, comfort, and everyday functionality.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated range of amenities designed to support both relaxation and active living. The development features a spacious swimming pool, fully equipped gym, children’s play areas, a scenic rooftop terrace, BBQ area, and even a dedicated pet washroom, reflecting the project’s practical and community-focused approach. With direct access to the main park, Alton offers an ideal setting for outdoor recreation, wellness, and a connected lifestyle within one of Dubai’s most vibrant residential communities.

Each apartment is finished with high-quality contemporary materials and carefully planned details that enhance both comfort and aesthetics. Interiors feature elegant porcelain flooring, built-in wardrobes, and en-suite bathrooms in the master bedrooms, while kitchens come fully equipped with German-made appliances. The residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering stylish, functional homes that are ready to complement a modern lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
